resources.string: Per-app statistics need Shizuku, root or ADB grants.
Battery details only. On this Android version, per-app statistics need Shizuku or root.
Shizuku is running. Authorize Voltwise to use it.
Voltwise is blocked in Shizuku (“Deny and don\'t ask again”). Open Shizuku, go to its authorized apps and switch Voltwise on.

Ordinary battery readings need no special access. Per-app statistics come from Android\'s own battery report, which needs Shizuku, root or ADB-granted permissions.\n\nAndroid counts those statistics since its own last reset, which can differ from Voltwise sessions.
Install and start Shizuku, then authorize Voltwise.
Allow Voltwise when your root manager asks, then check again.
From a computer with ADB, run these commands, then check again.
On Android 16 and later, these grants cover battery details but not per-app statistics.
Detected by checking the charge counter.
Not checked yet. The Android standard is used until enough readings are in.

Phones report battery current in different ways: some in milliamps instead of microamps, some with drain as a positive number. Voltwise checks the reported current against the charge counter while it monitors, and corrects the display.\n\nYou can set the unit and sign yourself in Settings, and reset the detection there.
